cases.name: Caroline Anne Ashworth
cases.narrative:
He laid in wait for her, shot her multiple times, then shot himself in the chest and head. Police said after she pulled into a condominium complex on Mountain Laurel Dr. he  shot her and then turned the gun on himself. “It sounds like they were broken up, she was driving his vehicle,” Chief Rafael Medina said. “We believe that she was meeting another person. He was lying in
wait.”
